cause_quote: The added condition `if (hasSqliteWorkerOutcomeUnknown(error) || isStateDatabaseAdmissionClosedError(error)) {` let exceptions from inspecting nested diagnostics escape because it ran before the existing `try` block.
user_saw: When a tool failed with unreadable nested error metadata, the agent turn stopped before the model could respond to the tool failure.
summary: The fix moved the admission-closed check into the existing diagnostics guard and kept the unknown-write check ahead of it.
reasoning: The parent commit already caught exceptions from nested storage diagnostics, and the earlier agent test explicitly expected a second model call after a tool error with unreadable nested metadata. The causing diff added a nested-error scan ahead of that catch, and the fix PR reports that the existing test then observed only one model call.
